offering_description.value: Provides grounds maintenance and landscape development for businesses, residential communities and public agencies. Local crews maintain landscapes year-round and install new landscapes, irrigation systems and hardscapes on site.

primary_services.value: grounds and turf maintenance; landscape design and installation; snow and ice removal; irrigation and water management; tree care

customer_segment.value: B2B: commercial property owners and managers, homeowners associations, real estate developers and private institutions; B2G: municipal agencies and other public property managers

end_markets.value: commercial real estate; managed residential communities; real estate development; institutional and municipal facilities; golf and sports venues

revenue_model.value: project or contract: recurring grounds maintenance agreements and landscape construction projects; service fees: per-event snow removal and separately ordered landscape enhancements

value_chain_position.value: service provider: uses crews, equipment and landscape materials to maintain and build outdoor spaces for property owners and managers

geography_served.value: US national: commercial properties across the United States

specialization.value: related lines: grounds maintenance, landscape development, snow removal, irrigation and tree care

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: local branch sales teams and national account teams

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: pesticide application under EPA and state rules, and field operations under OSHA safety standards
